Senses.Explanation: Or perhaps this is not yet so. Eryin Mi closes a donation-feast address with it, sending the assembly back to their own bodies when the offered vision is not yet realized, Huanxi Weiyi caps a hall address on readiness with a verse image when the assembly cannot equal it, and Wuyi Yuanlai forks his 'how old is Boshan' challenge into a meeting on another peak forty years back. Poshan Haiming keeps his vision of buddhas and ancestors standing while turning to inscribe a plaque, Tian'an Sheng pivots from 'the teaching has no many words' to a separate path, Hongzhi Zhengjue asks a knowing one to say through his inaugural document, Liao'an Qingyu warns auditors not to claim they saw him in thirty years, Yinyuan Longqi opens a gap in the line at a memorial rite, Baichi Xingyan lets even lantern and pillar keep deceiving each other, and Wuming Huijing, quoted inside a case compilation, marks the fork at which the outsider becomes a buddha or stays an outsider.
